text: Prepare the next PowerPoint presentation for the upcoming iteration.
The meeting identified multiple usability and reliability concerns: older generation usability difficulty, complex remote-control design, and Windows-like OS confusion.
No large-print option currently exists; consider adding one, though the cost implications are unclear.

Decisions set the selling price at Seventeen Pounds, target an international market, pursue a first-year profit target of fifty million Euros, and require accessibility and user-friendliness for all ages.
All roster members will begin their individual tasks after this meeting.
